answer: The trellis holds work receipts rather than names, so the onyx of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
